class.name: X25519Keypair
class.brief_description: A container for a pure X25519 keypair.
class.description: Holds a 32-byte X25519 private scalar and 32-byte public key. The private key is wiped from memory when the object is destroyed. Returned by [method X25519.generate_keypair].

method.name: get_private_key
method.description: Returns a copy of the 32-byte X25519 private scalar.
